tools.name: proxmox_list_nodes
tools.description: List all Proxmox nodes in the cluster with their health status (online/offline), CPU model, core count, and memory usage.

tools.name: proxmox_get_node_status
tools.description: Get detailed resource usage for a specific node: CPU usage (%), load average, memory (total/used), swap, uptime, and root disk usage.

tools.name: proxmox_list_guests
tools.description: List all VMs (QEMU) and LXC containers. Optionally filter by node, guest type ('qemu' or 'lxc'), or both.

type.description: Filter by guest type: 'qemu' for virtual machines, 'lxc' for containers (optional)

tools.name: proxmox_get_guest_status
tools.description: Get detailed runtime status of a specific VM or LXC container: CPU usage, memory usage, disk throughput, network traffic, uptime, and QEMU/LXC process info.

node.description: Node name where the guest runs

tools.name: proxmox_get_guest_config
tools.description: Get the full configuration of a VM or LXC container: CPU cores, memory, disks, network interfaces, OS type, startup order, and other settings.

node.description: Node name where the guest is defined

tools.name: proxmox_get_cluster_resources
tools.description: Get an overview of all cluster resources — nodes, VMs, containers, and storage — with their status and resource usage in a single call. Optionally filter by resource type.

type.description: Filter by resource type (optional). 'vm' includes both qemu and lxc.

tools.name: proxmox_get_storage
tools.description: Get storage pool details for a node or the whole cluster: pool name, type (lvm, zfs, dir, nfs, ceph, etc.), total space, used space, and availability.

node.description: Filter to a specific node (optional — omit for all nodes)

tools.name: proxmox_get_version
tools.description: Get the Proxmox VE version and repository info for one or all nodes.

node.description: Node name (optional — omit to get version from all nodes)
